trigger.method: trigger-runner.mjs: the description is copied verbatim into a probe skill in a fresh project, and each query runs as a nested `claude -p` with no user settings, plugins, hooks or MCP. A run counts as TRIGGERED only when the Skill tool fires for that probe. best_score and accuracy are over (case, rep) rows.
